lit-loop.reason: Claude's lit-loop is intentionally a self-contained hook-and-skill contract; the sibling Codex port includes several compiled runtime modules that Claude Code does not load, so comparing those host-specific implementation files would misclassify a native divergence.

skills.lit-burnoff-file: The single file gives a bounded smell taxonomy, preservation rules, process, and report shape; no corpus is needed for this review.
skills.autoconference: The adapter names the packaged conference closure, whose modes, references, templates, scripts, and assets are included in the pack.
skills.autoresearch: The adapter names the packaged research closure, whose bounded modes, references, templates, scripts, and assets are included in the pack.
skills.comment-checker: The file completely bounds comment intent, stale-narration checks, exceptions, process, and evidence for a procedural pass.
skills.lit-commit: The file specifies read-only state inventory, operation gates, staging and history safety, and receipts for Git work.
skills.lit-crucible: Discovery, lane design, contradiction checks, synthesis, and handoff rules form a complete planning procedure without a promised corpus.
skills.lit-init: Hierarchy discovery, complexity scoring, placement, generation, and verification are a complete bounded instruction-surface workflow.
skills.lit-handoff: The adapter resolves the packaged handoff closure; the pack includes its template, example, evaluation, and source-pointer files.
skills.lit-loop: The body supplies the complete PIN, RED, GREEN, surface, cleanup, evidence, and stop loop in its own contract.
skills.lit-plan: Decision-complete plan fields, authority boundaries, adaptive checklist depth, review, and validation are complete in the document.
skills.lit-recap: The read-only recap contract identifies state sources, evidence hierarchy, output shape, and stale-state handling in one file.
skills.lit-scientific-visualization: The adapter resolves the packaged visualization closure; styles, palettes, references, export scripts, evaluations, and tests are packed.
skills.litgoal: The body names the packaged goal CLI and state runtime; atomic ledger and quality-gate modules are shipped with it.
skills.litresearch: The body defines a bounded research workflow and the only extra file is attribution metadata; no unshipped corpus is claimed.
skills.litwork: The detailed body is backed by package-owned runtime bindings and fully specifies bounded delivery, evidence gates, manual QA, cleanup, and failure handling.
skills.lsp: The file scopes the host LSP tool and configuration, diagnostics workflow, and capability evidence without promising a missing corpus.
skills.refactor: Characterization-first refactoring, structural strategy, safety boundaries, verification, and rollback evidence are complete in the file.
skills.lit-burnoff: Test locking, categorized cleanup rules, meaning-preservation constraints, batch discipline, and verification form a complete procedure.
skills.review-work: Objective-achievability review, DoneClaim skepticism, evidence requirements, and release and dirty-state checks are fully bounded.
skills.rules: Rule-loading precedence, matcher behavior, hook safety, and verification paths form a complete bounded documentation surface.
skills.start-work: Approved-plan loading, durable lifecycle transitions, authority grants, per-checkbox gates, continuation, and cleanup are fully specified.
skills.structural-search: Identity-safe capability probing, structural and lexical fallback, preview, rewrite boundaries, and evidence are complete instructions.
skills.wikify: The adapter names the packaged wikify closure; its commands, assets, source skill, and license are included in the pack.
